name: Immigration case portal
note: A multi-role case management platform for an immigration practice: clients, staff and admins in one system, replacing spreadsheets and email.
problem: Every case lived in spreadsheets and email. Clients, paralegals and attorneys chased status through different channels, and manual handoffs caused errors and a steady stream of “where’s my case?” messages.

approach.title: Roles
approach.text: Separate views for applicants, attorneys, case managers and admins, with access enforced on the server.

approach.title: One source of truth
approach.text: A normalised PostgreSQL case model replaced the scattered spreadsheets.

approach.title: Self-service
approach.text: Clients check status, upload documents and get updates without emailing staff.

approach.title: Document workflows
approach.text: Checklists and review stages per case type, so nothing gets missed.

approach.title: Audit trail
approach.text: Every status change is recorded for compliance and accountability.

results.label: system instead of spreadsheets and email
audit trail of every status change

features: Client dashboard with active cases and pending documents
Applications list with status per case
Document vault with verified, pending and missing states
Email and Google sign-in with consent capture

testimonial.quote: Venus brings both technical depth and product thinking.
testimonial.name: Dhruvini G.
